title: Watch: Macron speaks to FRANCE 24 as Africa Forward Summit wraps up
summary: As the Africa Forward Summit comes to a close, French President Emmanuel Macron is speaking to journalists from FRANCE 24, RFI and TV5Monde in the Kenyan capital of Nairobi about what the president describes as a new model of partnership between Paris and African nations. Watch the full interview on FRANCE 24 from 9PM Paris time.
